info.name: LIV-119 · S3-US01-T02 · Staff Review over Gateway
info.description: API acceptance for Staff Review (API-115/116/120) via the API Gateway. Covers happy path, authentication, cross-tenant denial with readback (no state mutation), role, If-Match/412/428, validation/BVA and Idempotency-Key. Requires seeded data — see tests/e2e/review-publish/README.md. Run: newman run LIV-119-staff-review.postman_collection.json -e <env>.json

item.name: 01 Happy path — queue/detail (API-115/116)
S3-REV-01 · Staff A sees own-tenant version in queue

exec: pm.test('Queue contains seeded version A', () => pm.expect(q.items.map(i => i.versionId)).to.include(pm.variables.get('versionIdAPass')));
pm.test('Queue contains only STAFF_REVIEW items', () => q.items.forEach(i => { pm.expect(i.state).to.eql('IN_REVIEW'); pm.expect(i.reviewStage).to.eql('STAFF_REVIEW'); }));
pm.test('Queue does NOT contain tenant B version', () => pm.expect(q.items.map(i => i.versionId)).to.not.include(pm.variables.get('versionIdB')));

item.name: S3-REV-02 · Staff A reads review context + strong ETag

exec: pm.test('Version in STAFF_REVIEW', () => { const v = pm.response.json().version; pm.expect(v.state).to.eql('IN_REVIEW'); pm.expect(v.reviewStage).to.eql('STAFF_REVIEW'); });

05 Happy path — decisions (API-120) + idempotency
S3-REV-40 · Staff A PASS → MANAGER_APPROVAL + new ETag
S3-REV-41 · Replay same Idempotency-Key + same payload → same outcome, no double decision

exec: pm.test('Same stored outcome', () => { const v = pm.response.json(); const prev = JSON.parse(pm.variables.get('passResponse')); pm.expect(v.state).to.eql(prev.state); pm.expect(v.reviewStage).to.eql(prev.reviewStage); pm.expect(String(v.revision)).to.eql(String(prev.revision)); });
